diaspora_bullets: Los Angeles' first Asian American mayor
Born in Kerala, she came to the United States at age six
news_summary: Kerala-born Los Angeles City Council member Nithya Raman, 45, has unseated incumbent Mayor Karen Bass, who conceded on Thursday after news organizations projected Raman's win.
payoff: Raman is the first Democratic Socialists of America member to lead Los Angeles.
